#| label: setup
import sys

ev, inst, log = rv.load()
ms = rv.load_milestones()
S = rv.SECTIONS

```{python}
#| label: intro
Markdown(f"""
{len(ms)} changes that shaped how the Turkish power market works today, in five sections: how the market was opened up, how power is traded,
who may generate and how, how the grid is run, and the transition to renewables, storage and electric vehicles.
Laws and regulations appear only as small tags; each card says what changed or what the rule was for, and where it was read.
The [method page](method.qmd) explains the source labels and what was not read, and [institutions](institutions.qmd) says who does what.
""")
```

:::

## Liberalisation of Turkish power {#lib}

From one state monopoly to separate segments, a regulator, consumer choice and a privatised distribution grid.

```{python}
#| label: lib
HTML(rv.section_html(ms, S[0]))
```

## Power market {#market}

How electricity is priced, traded and settled, from the first balancing rules to EPİAŞ's markets.

```{python}
#| label: market
HTML(rv.section_html(ms, S[1]))
```

## Generation {#generation}

Who may build a plant and on what terms: renewable support, pre-licences and unlicensed generation.

```{python}
#| label: generation
HTML(rv.section_html(ms, S[2]))
```

## Grid and system operation {#grid}

The transmission company, the link to the European grid, metering, and how the system operator reaches plants and storage.

```{python}
#| label: grid
HTML(rv.section_html(ms, S[3]))
```

## Transition {#transition}

Renewable reforms, storage, aggregation, certificates, carbon pricing and electric vehicles.

## Download

```{python}
#| label: download
out = ev.drop(columns=["when"])
HTML(cs.download_link(ms, "tr_power_lab_market_milestones.csv", "Milestones (CSV)")
     + cs.download_link(out, "tr_power_lab_regulation_instruments.csv", "Instruments (CSV)")
     + cs.download_link(inst, "tr_power_lab_institutions.csv", "Institutions (CSV)")
     + cs.download_link(log, "tr_power_lab_regulation_research_log.csv", "Research log (CSV)"))
```

In the milestones file, `section` is one of the five sections, `topics` the filter topics, `tags` the legal tags and `instruments` the ids of
the underlying rows in the instruments file, where `parent` links each instrument to the one it rests on and `status` is `verified` or `draft`.
